title: Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2017 (EESM17)
description: The Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2017 (EESM17) dataset contains overnight recordings from 9 healthy participants, made at the participants' homes. Recordings combine partial polysomnography (scalp EEG, EOG, chin EMG) with 14 ear-EEG electrodes. A pre-sleep wake recording and a night-time sleep recording are provided for each subject, with sleep scoring beginning at lights out.
methods_description: Each participant completed two recordings at home. In the first, a 'wake' task, they relaxed in a chair reading or watching television. In the second, a 'sleep' task, they were recorded overnight from the time they went to bed. Recording equipment was mounted in the afternoon. Partial PSG (EEG, EOG, chin EMG) was combined with 14 ear-EEG electrodes, and the data are stored in EEGLAB .set format. Two ear-EEG channels, ERB1 and ELB1, were not used in the original study but are included in the dataset.
